channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Why You Can Get Fined for Driving Without Insurance in Texas
item.description: Driving in Texas comes with certain responsibilities, and one of the most important ones is having car insurance.

item.title: Hulne: Sports remind us of our own mortality
item.description: A former weekend warrior reflects on fading pickup games, empty gyms and how aging out of sports forces us to confront our own mortality.

item.title: How Rising Interest Rates Are Affecting Homeowners in Mid-Sized U.S. Cities
item.description: Rising interest rates continue to reshape the U.S. housing market, and their impact is being felt most clearly in mid-sized cities where affordability, stability, and long-term homeownership have traditionally been selling points.

item.title: Port Authority waives restriction for Younkers building, Goodwill location eyed to fill the property
item.description: Austin Port Authority clears tax rule hurdle so Goodwill can lease former Younkers building, with $2M upgrades and room left for a second tenant.

item.title: Closing statement: Packer girls hockey team outlasts Winhawks
item.description: Louks' two goals and Haedt's 22 saves power Austin past Winona 3-1, capping the Packers' best season since 2021-22 and positioning them to host a Section 1A playoff game.

item.title: Blossom girls take down USC
item.description: Blooming Prairie girls top United South Central 64-51 as Emmerson Nelson scores 16 and Ella Salinas adds 13, lifting BP to 12-7 overall and dropping USC to 7-12.

item.title: Staloch nets 30 to lead Blossoms over USC
item.description: Gabe Staloch scores 30 as Blooming Prairie beats United South Central 82-59 on the road, improving to 14-4 overall.

item.title: Razorbacks top Packers and Winhawks in Austin
item.description: Westfield Razorbacks defeat Austin 51-18 and Winona 54-24 in Austin, as Busho, Butteris, Miller, Clennon and Tidemann all go 2-0.

item.title: Rebel girls run past Saint Charles
item.description: Double-doubles from Breeley Galle and Brynlee Koenigs lead Southland to a 65-43 win at Saint Charles, pushing the Rebels to 15-2.

item.title: Walker hits seven threes to lead Vikings past Medford
item.description: Charlie Walker’s seven threes power Hayfield past Medford 74-55, as he scores 31 points to lead the Vikings to their 11th win of the season.
